scientific_integrity: Proof uses an explicit 32-vertex realization, zonotope facet and volume identities, exhaustive exact integer-algebra determinant enumeration, and a multilinearity argument. No probabilistic sampling or numerical tolerance establishes the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The 39-level distribution applies to tetrahedra supported at four distinct vertices; the sharp maximum and complete rigidity theorem apply to every contained tetrahedron. Exact finite algebraic enumeration is reproducible but independently unreviewed. Historical priority is not established conclusively.
title: Sharp tetrahedral rigidity and complete vertex-volume spectrum of the rhombic triacontahedron
